svg.title: \begin{array}{ll} \text{maximize}&\lambda,\\ \text{subject to}&x^\omega_j\in P(f_{\omega,j})\quad(\omega,j),\\ &x^\omega_j(p)=0\quad(p\notin I),\\ &\sum_j v_{\omega,p,j}x^\omega_j(p)\ge\lambda \quad(\omega,\ p\in I),\\ &\sum_{p,j}a_{\omega,p,j}x^\omega_j(p) \le C_\omega-\sigma(I)\quad(\omega),\\ &0\le\lambda\le V, \end{array} \tag{RA16}
